node.title: when to capitalize package variables
node.author: Lotus1
node.doctext:
I need to provide a package variable in a module I'm working on to let the user turn on or off a feature. It's a simple non object oriented module. I've used [mod://Data::GUID::Any] before and remembered there is a package variable called UC that is used exactly like what I want to do. The user can get lower case GUIDs by setting it to false but it defaults to positive.

local $Data::GUID::Any::UC; guid_as_string(); # will be lower case

My question is since this variable isn't a constant should it be uppercase? Perhaps the author just wanted to avoid having it look similar to uc().
